Antes del fuego ♫ Música recomendada para acompañar la lectura: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rQ_box0VEEM Demasiadas palabras, se dijo, mirando el borrador sobre la mesa. Consumió muy poco tiempo en el que invirtió mucho de sí para llenar unas páginas carentes de vida, de fuerza, y pensó en el fuego. Se concedió un poco más de tiempo. Antes del fuego venía la guillotina. Cuando encontrase las fuerzas agotadas en tan burda empresa, desmenuzaría aquella amorfa masa de palabras en busca de su verdadero valor. Y tiró su manuscrito al abismo de un cajón con otros textos a la espera de su veredicto. Pasaron tantos días que alcanzaron el olvido. Una mañana, levantado con muy buen humor, se aventuró a coger uno al azar de aquellos manuscritos. La distracción, los viajes por su mundo, placeres que se había negado, le devolvieron la energía y el optimismo que necesitaba. Después de sus correrías volvió a necesitar recogimiento y regresó a la escritura. Era el momento de las correcciones. Sin mirar el título ni recordar la trama original, empezó a leer armado con un plumín que apoyó sobre las primeras líneas. Llegó a la primera sangría. No le tembló el pulso al ejecutar su primera y urgente amputación, que suprimió con un trazo firme y horizontal. Al mismo tiempo, un aire inexplicablemente gélido le erizó el vello de los brazos cuando levantó la mano armada. Alzó la mirada en dirección al ventanal cerrado de su estudio y la luz de la mañana perdió todos los matices. Parpadeó extrañado. Avanzó dos renglones, llevado por la inercia de un corrector que no admitía pausas; pero una coma entorpecía la marcha del personaje. Con la misma saña con la que eliminó un adjetivo, tachó un signo de puntuación con un resultado impredecible: una punzada de dolor lo dejó sin aliento unos segundos, postrado sobre su mesa de trabajo. Cuando se recuperó, buscó la siguiente frase recargada. Entró de lleno en el siguiente párrafo y allí cargó contra tres líneas completas de descripción ornamental que le sobraban. Tachó, implacable, atravesando el texto de izquierda a derecha. Se detuvo un instante con la vista en el papel y luego la alzó mientras se disolvían sus libros en el aire. Miró el plumín y la siguiente corrección por ejecutar. Encontró un sujeto que impedía la concisión del cierre. Eliminarlo elevaría a la perfección el texto. Sobre su mano temblorosa le cayó una gota de sudor. Dudó un instante antes de apretar el trazo. #delirio #introspeccion #metaliteratura #relatoCorto #surrealista

Sismo de magnitud 7.7 sacude Panamá este lunes; epicentro se ubicó cerca de Río Grande Un sismo preliminar de magnitud 7.7 se registró en Panamá, a 10 kilómetros de profundidad y cerca de Río Grande. La información sobre posibles daños y personas afectadas está pendiente de confirmación. Por Gabriela Díaz | Reportera Un sismo preliminar de magnitud 7.7 se registró este lunes 12 de octubre en Panamá, con epicentro localizado a 18.3 kilómetros al oeste de Río Grande y una profundidad estimada de 10 kilómetros, de acuerdo con el informe inicial del Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS). El movimiento telúrico fue ubicado en las coordenadas 7.703 grados de latitud norte y 81.499 grados de longitud oeste. Los parámetros corresponden a una evaluación preliminar y pueden modificarse conforme avance el análisis sismológico. Hasta el momento, la información disponible para esta nota no permite confirmar si el nuevo movimiento provocó daños materiales, personas lesionadas o víctimas mortales. Tampoco se cuenta con información confirmada sobre una eventual alerta de tsunami asociada con este evento. ¿Dónde ocurrió el sismo de magnitud 7.7 en Panamá? El reporte inicial del USGS sitúa el epicentro cerca de Río Grande, en la provincia de Veraguas, en una región que registró actividad sísmica importante durante los días anteriores. Las localidades más cercanas al punto del movimiento, según el informe preliminar, son: Río Grande: 18.3 kilómetros al este del epicentro. Santiago de Veraguas: 71.8 kilómetros al noreste. Monagrillo: 121.6 kilómetros al este-noreste. Pocrí: 121.6 kilómetros al este-noreste. San Juan Bautista: 122.9 kilómetros al este-noreste. La profundidad estimada de 10 kilómetros corresponde a un sismo superficial. Este factor puede influir en la intensidad de las sacudidas en la superficie, aunque los efectos también dependen de la distancia al epicentro, las características del suelo y la resistencia de las construcciones. Panamá mantiene antecedentes recientes de actividad sísmica El nuevo movimiento se produce después del terremoto de magnitud 7.7 registrado el 9 de octubre en Panamá, que ocasionó afectaciones en viviendas, centros educativos, instalaciones sanitarias y tramos de infraestructura vial. Los reportes difundidos durante los días posteriores documentaron daños en distintas localidades y la continuidad de las evaluaciones de las autoridades. La actividad sísmica posterior incluyó numerosas réplicas, por lo que resulta importante diferenciar cada evento y verificar sus efectos por separado. La ocurrencia de un nuevo sismo no permite determinar por sí sola si habrá movimientos de mayor magnitud. Tampoco es posible establecer el alcance de los daños únicamente a partir de la magnitud registrada. –sn– Sociedad Noticias ¡Conéctate con Sociedad Noticias ! Her debut novel, A Storm Inside Her is coming out on Saturday, October 17th (only 5 days away!), and she has a sweet letter to share with you, reminding us who we write for . Dear Writer… Dear writer, Yes, you. The one standing there, a story in your hands, a hope in your heart. You with the beautiful, wild imagination and the desire to write for His glory. You with the doubts and struggles and what if s piling up inside. Did you know that your story is being written as we speak? Did you know that the greatest Storyteller of all is the one authoring your fairytale? He is penning the thump thump thump of your heart, the whoosh of breath, skritch of your pen. God is writing your story. So why wouldn’t you write for his glory? He gave you this gift of words. He gave you this passion for writing. He looked down into the world and decided to place you into it, planting a great big imagination inside you. So remember to write with Him in mind. I’m not saying your story necessarily has to be about someone finding Christ or strengthening their faith. If that’s what He’s put on your heart, then of course write that! It’s beautiful and worshipful and true. However, maybe you have an epic adventure in mind, set in a sprawling fantasy world, where that’s not quite possible. And that’s okay. This story—it is good and beautiful for you to write it. But I’d just like to urge you to think, Where can I write hope into this? Where can I write light into this? Where can I write in a way that points towards the truth? It doesn’t have to be obvious or extreme…but just ponder, where can you shine God’s light and love throughout your story? Where can you point towards the Author of all creation? Recently, I’ve been thinking about the importance of hope in our stories. Because it’s powerful, this thing called hope. It lifts the reader up, leaving them with something they might not have known they needed. It can shine a little light into whatever darkness they are walking through. But how do we write hope into our stories? Sometimes, the little things are the most meaningful. It can be in the way friends carry each other’s burdens; the way a character’s faith holds them up even in the hard times; the way someone finds joy despite their circumstances. It can be in the quiet moments between family, in a child’s strong, beautiful faith, in a character noticing the glory of God’s creation even as they are walking through hard times. It can be in sunlight shining through rain or in laughter through tears. Hope can also be written into our stories in big ways, such as miracles, someone finding their faith, or light defeating the darkness. And that’s something I wanted to talk about as well: how, when we write our stories, we can be honest about the darkness. We don’t have to hide the fact that we do live in a broken world. We don’t have to ignore the scars of this life. The pain, the hurting, the shadows that bring tears to our eyes and a suffocating ache to our chests. Because, maybe, if you write about something that someone out there thought they were completely alone in…that could change their life. If you acknowledge a painful reality, but show that there is hope and that they are not the only one going through this struggle…that could be the most powerful thing of all. I’ve read stories that have made me feel less alone. I’ve read stories that have made me feel seen. I’ve read stories that have made tears rush to my eyes because I saw myself in these characters and their struggles…and I saw hope where there used to be none. Here’s the thing: when we hide the darkness, that diminishes the power of the light. So don’t be afraid to show the brokenness of this world…but never forget to write hope and light between the pages. Because the One we are writing for? He is the One in whom we put our hope, the One who is the light. When we write stories filled with hope, we are pointing towards the greatest Storyteller of all. You have been given this desire for writing by the Author of all things. Remember that. Remember who you are writing for. Something that I’ve been praying about a lot is that God would use my stories to bring someone hope. I pray that these words that I’ve written could lift someone up and point them towards Him. That He would use this story for His glory, that these words would be a light shining towards Him who wrote the very beating of our hearts. That is my dream: that the stories God gave me to write would be a light in any way He chooses. And I hope He will do that through your writing too. Let Him into your writing, ask that He will use your stories for his purposes, and pray that He will be the one at the center of word that leaves your hand. Breathe deep, dear writer. Because the one who writes our stories, the one who wrote the story of the entire universe…He’s got you. He’s holding you in his arms, you His child, you who He loves. Honestly, that’s what I hope you know: that the Author of all creation loves you so incredibly much. And I hope that will inspire you to write for His glory. Blessings, Lola Mae About the Author Lola Mae is a homeschooled (for her whole life until high school) military brat with a love for her family, wolves, and Jesus. Most importantly, Lola is a Child of God, and she writes with the prayer that her stories will be a light for Christ. Telling tales of faith and hope is her passion, and she’s never lived a moment without something brewing in her imagination. When she’s not scribbling in a notebook under a tree, playing with her (spoiled-with-love) dog, running on trails, laughing with her delightful family, or hiking somewhere in the woods, you can find her rambling about writing, wolves, and worship on her website or up in the clouds, tucked away in her imagination. Thanks, Lola Mae! I hope this sweet post is an encouragement to everyone who reads it! And… a quick spotlight on A Storm Inside Her , Lola Mae’s DEBUT, coming out this Saturday ! After a wildfire ends the lives of her parents, Paloma follows her mother’s dying wish to bring the realms back together. Tsunami begins a similar journey when her sister and father are kidnapped. She chases after them, but soon loses their scent and decides to try to reunite the realms—and, in the process, hopes to reunite her family too. Told in alternating perspectives, A Storm Inside Her chronicles the adventures of the two determined pups as they begin their journeys and eventually meet, teaming up on their quest. But with Darkness shadowing their steps and enemies on their tails, can Paloma and Tsunami fulfill their desperate dreams?
